provenance.sourceRelationship: QuantumGraph constructs and normalizes the reviewed court-ring coupling map; an ExpectationValue k=2 backend avoids a redundant finite-shot acquisition during graph construction. After the authored preparation is installed on that graph, the pinned pairwise-tomography package generates one nine-setting bipartite batch and fits all four edge density matrices. The three uniform settings in that same batch supply the complete A/B/C/D gameplay distributions; edges are explanatory and are never sampled independently during play.
provenance.lineage: Fluxball follows Quantum Royale's offline QuantumGraph and pairwise-tomography acquisition pattern, but adds full-register sampling so four players receive one compatible joint rule outcome.

calibration.claimBoundary: The shallow rational-angle preparation was authored so both global parities and all player signs remain legible. This is game-design calibration, not full state tomography, entanglement certification, quantum advantage, a hardware-feasibility result, or a scientific optimum.
